core_obligations: Note that one implication is immediate because pullback preserves pseudo-coherence (proof lines 3078-3080).

For the converse, reduce to an affine open of the base: cover it by finitely many affine opens of the members of the covering, replace the covering by the single induced flat surjective morphism of finite presentation, so it suffices to treat the case of one such morphism over an affine base (proof lines 3080-3094).

Argue by induction on the bound m: since the pullback of the complex is m-pseudo-coherent, its top cohomology in degree m is a finite type module, and finiteness descends along the flat surjection, so a finite type module on the base maps onto that cohomology (proof lines 3095-3105).

Lift the map to the complex, form the distinguished triangle with the cone, verify that the cone is again m-pseudo-coherent after pullback and concentrated in lower degrees, apply the induction hypothesis to it, and conclude that the original complex is m-pseudo-coherent (proof lines 3106-3115).
proof_roadmap: The easy direction by pullback (proof lines 3078-3080).
Reduction to an affine base and a single flat surjection (proof lines 3080-3094).
Induction on the degree using descent of finiteness and the cone (proof lines 3095-3115).
